title: A literal URL at the HTTP client is not read while checking.
text: `rule:security/outbound-url-is-a-sink` says a literal at an outbound URL parameter is validated while checking (`rule:expressions/intrinsic-literals`), and ADR 0058's M8 list asks for a malformed literal URL to be a compile error. The roster has a row for `Core\Uri::parse` and none for `Core\Http\Client`'s request members or `Core\Http::allowUrl`, so `Core\Http\Client::get("ht tp://exa mple")` compiles while the same literal at `Core\Uri::parse` is `E0769`. Closing it is a row per member whose `url` parameter is a sink, read with the URI grammar, and a reject case beside `tests/conformance/reject/a-malformed-literal-intrinsic-is-a-compile-error.nvst`.
